intro: Checks wastegate size, spring and boost control so you hold the target pressure without boost creep.

r.spring_manual: Without a controller: spring = target boost
r.spring_ctrl: With a controller: about 70% of the target
r.duty_note: Linear approximation, fine-tune on the car

warn.creep_high: Valve clearly too small: boost may keep rising (boost creep).
warn.creep_moderate: Valve marginal: slight boost creep is possible at high rpm.
warn.use_external: The requirement exceeds an internal flapper's capacity: switch to an external wastegate.
warn.spring_manual: Without a controller, boost equals the spring pressure: choose a spring equal to the target.
warn.spring_low: Spring weak compared with the target: unstable control and boost spikes are possible.
warn.spring_high: Spring close to the target: the controller has almost no range left.
warn.target_unreachable: Target above what the controller can hold with this spring: fit a stiffer spring.
warn.oversized: Valve much larger than needed: slightly less precise control, but safe.
